name: codex-hat
description: Sort tasks across supported Codex models and reasoning efforts

interface.shortDescription: Put each Codex task under the right model.
interface.longDescription: Act as a sorting hat for Codex tasks: classify task type, difficulty, risk, and parallelism, then route work to a supported Sol, Terra, or Luna model and reasoning effort.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-hat to select and run the best Codex model for this task.
